environment.mode: Next.js dev --webpack; React Compiler enabled; StrictMode disabled

methodology.timing: requestAnimationFrame callback cadence, not independently measured compositor FPS
methodology.input: Synthetic PointerEvents dispatched through the real React playback handlers
methodology.gap: Largest uncovered viewport interval between mounted column wrappers, excluding intentional space before chord 0
methodology.gestureStatistics: Active gesture interval; maximum callback gap and long tasks include the full run, including release/settle
limitations: Development build, one desktop machine, foreground browser
Narrow viewport retains desktop user agent; no real touch hardware, Safari, Android, production profile, CPU throttling, or GPU trace
Probe samples computed transforms and mounted geometry every frame, adding measurement overhead
Paused state fields inferred through React internals in the initial probe were discarded. Retained results use store state and DOM geometry. The saved probe has no React-internals dependency.
